items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think informally studying with him some way. He came with me for a week to Detroit with Ronnie Ball and Al Levitt.

ctx.x: Yeah. They started out with this tune at this tempo [taps a fast tempo] and [on] some other tunes I’ve heard Warne with Niels Henning and Al Levitt playing very fast tempos very flawlessly. Do you know the book this man in Australia wrote?
Safford Chamberlain, the biography of Warne?
